SourceProxy.name: SHYXAlphaWrapping
SourceProxy.label: SHYX Alpha Wrapping

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Alpha Wrapping: Watertight 2-manifold wrap (CGAL); Alpha/Offset follow the mesh size.

SourceProxy.Documentation: CGAL alpha wrapping of a point cloud or triangle soup into a watertight, orientable 2-manifold that strictly encloses the input (same backend as VESPA Alpha Wrapping). Alpha and Offset are absolute lengths. 0 (default) uses 5% and 3% of the longest AABB side (BoundsDomain scaled_extent); Scale/Reset next to the properties fills that suggestion. Unlike VESPA, there is no percentage-of-diagonal mode. Field data SHYXAlphaWrappingAlpha / SHYXAlphaWrappingOffset record the values used.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Alpha
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Alpha
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Maximum circumradius of wrap faces. 0 (default) uses 0.05 times the longest side of the input axis-aligned bounding box (BoundsDomain scaled_extent). Smaller values follow concavities more closely. The panel Scale/Reset controls fill that suggestion.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Offset
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Offset
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Dilatation of the wrap relative to the input. Must stay positive after auto-resolve. 0 (default) uses 0.03 times the longest AABB side (BoundsDomain scaled_extent). The panel Scale/Reset controls fill that suggestion.

IntVectorProperty.name: UpdateAttributes
IntVectorProperty.label: Interpolate attributes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, interpolate input point/cell attributes onto the wrap (vtkCGALPolyDataAlgorithm).
